questions.scenario: You are ordering food on Zomato or Swiggy. What is your style?

options.text: I track the delivery guy on the map and go down exactly when he arrives.
I apply 3 different promo codes and calculate the maximum discount mathematically.
I browse the menu mostly looking at the aesthetic and mouth-watering food photos.
I ask everyone what they want and place one large organized group order.

questions.scenario: You are playing a multiplayer mobile game (like BGMI or Free Fire) with friends.

options.text: I do everything—driving the jeep, looting, and shooting at the front.
I memorize the map, plan the strategy, and track the safe zone shrinking.
I spend time unlocking the coolest skins, emotes, and outfits for my character.
I turn on the mic and give strict commands to the squad on where to land.

questions.scenario: It's Diwali time and you have to decorate the entire house. What is your job?

options.text: Hanging the lights, cleaning the fans, and doing all the heavy physical lifting.
Figuring out the complex extension board wiring so nothing short-circuits.
Making the most beautiful, intricate, and colorful Rangoli at the entrance.
Managing the budget for crackers, sweets, and assigning tasks to siblings.

questions.scenario: Your school is organizing a massive farewell party for the seniors.

options.text: I run around managing the stage setup, food stalls, and music system physically.
I handle the complex Excel sheet of student contributions and the exact event schedule.
I design the invitation cards and select the visual theme and decorations.
I pitch the whole event idea to the Principal to get the final approval and budget.

questions.scenario: When a gadget breaks at home (like a TV remote or fan), what do you do?

options.text: I open it up with a screwdriver, clean the dust, and try to fix it hands-on.
I Google the exact error code or read the manual to understand the hidden logic.
I tape it back together neatly so it at least looks perfectly fine from the outside.
I calculate if it's cheaper to repair it or just order a new upgraded one online.

questions.scenario: You are buying a new smartphone. What matters the most to you?

options.text: Testing the physical feel, the camera, and the overall speed before buying.
Comparing RAM, processor benchmarks, and exact battery capacity numbers.
The color, the display quality, and how sleek and stylish the UI looks.
Waiting for the Big Billion Days sale to get the absolute best exchange value.

questions.scenario: Board Exams are approaching. What is your actual study strategy?

options.text: I solve previous year's sample papers by writing everything down practically.
I try to understand the deep core formulas and concepts instead of just memorizing.
I highlight my notes with 4 different colored pens and aesthetic sticky notes.
I make a strict 30-day timetable on my wall and track my syllabus progress.

questions.scenario: When you watch a Bollywood movie, what goes through your mind?

options.text: I just enjoy the action scenes, dance numbers, and the full entertainment vibe.
I try to logically guess the suspense or plot twists before they actually happen.
I notice the camera angles, the beautiful locations, and the actor's outfits.
I check the box office collection and wonder how much profit the producers made.

questions.scenario: You are planning a trip with friends. What is your designated role?

options.text: I am the one carrying the speaker, snacks, and keeping the energy high.
I check Google Maps, train timings, and weather forecasts perfectly.
I am the designated photographer making sure everyone's Insta-stories look great.
I collect money from everyone, manage the budget, and book the tickets.

questions.scenario: When using an app like Instagram, what do you usually do?

options.text: I scroll, comment, post stories, and use all the features constantly.
I wonder how their algorithm knows exactly what reels to show me.
I edit my photos with filters and make sure my profile grid looks aesthetic.
I look at influencers and figure out how they are making money from brand deals.

Full_Stack_Developer.title: Full Stack Developer / Software Engineer
Full_Stack_Developer.primary_match_text: You are a versatile all-rounder! You like to build things from start to finish and aren't afraid of getting into the practical mechanics.
Full_Stack_Developer.day_in_the_life: Building complete web platforms, writing both the front-end buttons and the back-end logic, and launching apps into the real world.
Full_Stack_Developer.alternative_match_text: Since you are highly adaptable and love hands-on work, you could also excel in Robotics or Core IT Engineering.
Full_Stack_Developer.roadmap: Take Science (PCM) in 11th/12th. Pursue a B.Tech in Computer Science (CSE) or BCA.

Backend_Developer.title: Backend Developer / Systems Architect
Backend_Developer.primary_match_text: You are the logical brain of the group. You love solving complex puzzles, managing data, and working behind the scenes to make things run flawlessly.
Backend_Developer.day_in_the_life: Writing complex algorithms, managing massive databases, and ensuring apps run super fast without crashing.
Backend_Developer.alternative_match_text: Because of your deep analytical thinking, you would also be amazing in Cyber Security or Financial Data Analysis.
Backend_Developer.roadmap: Take Science (PCM) in 11th/12th. Pursue a B.Tech in Computer Science (CSE) or B.Sc in IT.

Frontend_Developer.title: Frontend Developer / UI-UX Engineer
Frontend_Developer.primary_match_text: You are highly creative and visual. You care deeply about how things look, feel, and the overall aesthetic experience people have.
Frontend_Developer.day_in_the_life: Designing beautiful app screens, picking the perfect colors and animations, and writing code that makes websites visually stunning.
Frontend_Developer.alternative_match_text: If you ever decide to step away from pure coding, your aesthetic sense makes you perfect for Graphic Design or Product Design.
Frontend_Developer.roadmap: Any stream works, but PCM or Commerce with Computers is good. Pursue a B.Tech in CSE, BCA, or a specialized UI/UX degree.

Tech_Product_Manager.title: Tech Product Manager / Startup Founder
Tech_Product_Manager.primary_match_text: You are a natural leader. You understand technology, but you prefer managing the business, leading the team, and making the final decisions.
Tech_Product_Manager.day_in_the_life: Leading a team of coders and designers, deciding what new features an app should have, and launching it successfully in the market.
Tech_Product_Manager.alternative_match_text: With your street-smart business mind, you could easily build your own tech startup or excel in Corporate Management.
Tech_Product_Manager.roadmap: Take Commerce or PCM in 11th/12th. Pursue a BBA in IT, B.Tech followed by an MBA, or B.Com.
